info.title: Lattice Design ML/Physics Engine Backend
info.description: Backend API for 3D lattice inverse design, surrogate property prediction, and physics verification.

Check the request against the dataset, reuse an identical earlier job, otherwise queue it. Returns 202.

get.description: Query current status, stage, progress, and results of a design job from SQLite.

delete.description: Stop a job: a queued job is cancelled at once, a running one after its current search round.

schema.title: Response Cancel Job Api Jobs  Job Id  Delete

post.description: Stop a job: a queued job is cancelled at once, a running one after its current search round.

schema.title: Response Cancel Job Api Jobs  Job Id  Cancel Post

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: one event whenever the job's state changes, a comment ping every SSE_PING_S seconds,
then a final `close`. Reads the job record, so any number of listeners see the same stream. The page falls
back to polling GET /api/jobs/{id} every 2 s if the stream drops.
Retrieve one saved candidate (lattice geometry, predicted and verified properties).

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: zone id -> candidate id, one per lattice zone

interface_mm.title: Interface Mm
interface_mm.description: thickness of the solid plate between zones (default 0.6)

AxisValues.title: AxisValues
AxisValues.description: Directional 3D physical property values (axes can be None).

match_error_pct.title: Match Error Pct
match_error_pct.description: Percentage error relative to target requirements

matches_targets.title: Matches Targets
matches_targets.description: True when the solver confirms every target

predicted.description: Properties predicted by the ML surrogate model

verified.description: Properties verified by the physics solver

source.title: Source
source.description: generated (made by the search) or nearest_stored (a lattice from the dataset)

mass_estimate.title: Mass Estimate
mass_estimate.description: mass_g is density x part volume x material density

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: Candidate lattice design with topology, predicted, and verified properties.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Design demo, not a medical device. Bone and load numbers are placeholders (source: TODO); nothing here is a clinical, safety or regulatory claim.

part.description: Target part dimensions and cell sizing

n_results.title: N Results

force.title: Force

DesignRequest.title: DesignRequest

DesignTarget.title: DesignTarget

HealthResponse.description: Backend service health and readiness status.

force_n.title: Force N

skipped_invalid.title: Skipped Invalid

reach.title: Reach

candidates.title: Candidates

request.title: Request

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a design search and verification job.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Node connectivity graph edge pairs [[node_a, node_b], ...]

LatticeSpec.description: Lattice graph topology and structural specifications.

size_mm.title: Size Mm

size_mm.title: Size Mm
size_mm.description: Bounding dimensions [x, y, z] in mm

stress_mpa.description: design stress: peak stress of the governing load case x safety factor
